A Terrible Experience. Never again

I called to ask about the price for my dog since it was my first time, and Annie told me that if I brought my dog that same day, she could provide a complete service that included a bath, nail trimming, teeth cleaning, ear cleaning, and anal gland cleaning for $100. However, she did clarify that if I return another day she couldn’t guarantee the same price because of my dogs size. A somewhat strange comment, but up to that point, everything was fine.

I decided to take my dog in, and was told it would be approximately 3 to 4 hours because they were very busy since it was a Saturday. However, they called me in less than an hour later to pick up my dog that they had finished. That was the first red flag.

When I arrived to pick up my dog, she looked exactly the same as when I dropped her off.  The only thing they did was trim her nails That’s it! She didn’t even smell good. For $100!!!!! Insane

I don’t understand how they can charge for a grooming service when clearly they didn’t do the work. What a scam and unfortunately You need to pay first before they bring your dog out. If I had known she was going to come out practically the same, I would have just trimmed her nails at home and saved my money.

The worst experience. I would never go back, and I definitely would not recommend this place. If you’re looking for complete and professional grooming for your pets, go somewhere else.
